package.name: WifiPacketRouterInterfaces
package.doc: The Wi-Fi packet router FPGA's internal interfaces: one role pair per pair of subsystems that exchange items in a scenario (the flows that cross subsystems in WifiPacketRouterBehavior). They carry items, not signals yet: how each is built in HDL (a stream, a register bus) is decided later.

portDefs.name: CommandController
portDefs.doc: Ethernet to processing: commands in, responses back (ReadTemperature: receiveFrame -> decodeCommand, buildResponse -> sendFrame).

portDefs.name: TempReadController
portDefs.doc: Processing to temp_if: a reading requested, the temperature back (ReadTemperature: decodeCommand -> readSensor -> buildResponse).
